item.title: North Dakota enacts tenure policy requiring master’s, advanced degrees
item.description: BISMARCK, N.D. (North Dakota Monitor) — The North Dakota State Board of Higher Education enacted a tenure policy requiring a master’s or other advanced degree for professors to receive tenure. The new policy passed the board in a unanimous vote Thursday and will not affect current tenured positions in the North Dakota University System, applying only to future tenure appointments....
